integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible standard-library checker supplied. Claims of independent validation or external certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to three-layer clique paths, n>=3. Exhaustive checks are finite (n=3,4,5), not substitutes for general proof. The full text of Henning 2017 was inaccessible and residual unindexed-priority risk remains.
title: Semitotal-domination and inclusion-minimality polynomials of three-layer clique paths
